before:
Declared rewriting, exact parametrization, and the composable-domain topology
jointly determine this semantics. Primitive word-code continuity and scoped
roundtrips preserve the trace-sensitive quotient under presentation changes;
conservative abbreviations and binary timing collisions show why the
observable topology has a sharper boundary. The literal-word correspondence
connects that distinction to the implemented flat model. Geometric circle,
torus, product, and rose results establish completeness in concrete
presentations, while the ordinary/final comparison identifies the additional
quotient condition needed for ordinary composition.
after:
The semantics depends on the declared rewrites, exact parametrization and
composable-domain topology. Continuous primitive word codes and scoped
roundtrips preserve the trace-sensitive quotient. Conservative abbreviations
and binary timing collisions can change the observable topology. Literal-word
correspondence connects the manuscript to the implemented flat model.
The circle, torus, product and geometric rose developments prove completeness
for concrete presentations. The ordinary/final criterion specifies the quotient
condition that yields ordinary composition continuity.
